title: aidd delegate check --json
description: Whether a delegated ask may go to the delegate: `eligible` only when every check passes, recomputed from git, the default branch's config, and the platform each time. A defer goes to the person. It exits 0 when eligible, 1 on a defer, and 2 on a usage error. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

outcome.description: `eligible`: start the delegate with the action, the command, and the head. `defer`: ask the person.

reserved.description: Whether a reason is a reserved one: the person decides, whatever the delegation says.

action.description: The action asked about, such as `pr.merge`.

covers.description: What an accept would cover: the exact command, with the trailers in its message, the head and its tree, the default branch's tip, the branch, and the Spec.

reasons.description: Why the check defers; empty when eligible.

warnings.description: What a person should know that defers nothing.

inputs.description: What the check read, such as `delegation_commit`, the commit whose config held the delegation, and the check run, for a person to read. Nothing reads it to decide.

trailers.description: On `eligible`: the `Decided-by`, `On-behalf-of`, and `Delegation` trailers a delegated commit or merge carries, never `Approved-by`.

next.description: The next step: `what` is one sentence.

reason_code.description: A reason the check defers. The `delegate` group of `schemas/findings.json` gives each one's meaning, whether it is reserved, and the next step.
